text:
ravi: quick check-in on the speculative sampler bring-up for titan-13b quant vs int8. ran a small A/B and seeing an odd pattern on long-horizon factual prompts
Nora: what pattern?
ravi: sampler (spec-v1) reduces median token latency by ~30% but we get a reproducible drop in factual accuracy on our trivia holdout (~2.1% exact match)
Liam: that's sizable. how large was the holdout and prompt mix?
ravi: 3.2k prompts: 50% trivia/fact, 30% multi-step instruction, 20% casual chat. temp=0.6 for all.
Priya: are both arms using the same quant artifact?
ravi: two arms: GPTQ 4-bit and an int8 per-channel run. baseline is greedy on GPTQ-4. sampler arm used GPTQ-4 + speculative prefill. we also ran a separate int8 baseline (no sampler) for comparison.
Nora: how does int8 compare on accuracy?
ravi: int8 baseline recovers about 1.5% of the EM drop vs GPTQ-4 baseline but costs ~12% extra latency. sampler+int8 still underperforms sampler+GPTQ by a hair on EM but has different error modes.
Liam: error modes?
ravi: sampler tends to truncate or collapse multi-hop chains into shorter statements; int8 introduces rare hallucinated facts (wrong numeric details) but keeps chain structure.
Priya: did you log token-level rescoring events and whether speculation was accepted or reverted?
ravi: yes — accept_rate=78% for sampler+GPTQ; top1_prob_drop average when reverting ~0.14. also captured per-token entropy and rerank delta.
Nora: could this be a prefix-warmup issue where KV-cache misses cause later tokens to be less informed?
ravi: plausible. instrument shows sampler sessions had ~9% fewer effective KV-warms in contexts >250 tokens.
Liam: how are you measuring factual accuracy? EM or BLEU/ROUGE?
ravi: exact match for trivia, micro-ROUGE-L for multi-step instruct. also track deterministic-rerank MRR for retrieval-assisted prompts.
Priya: we should run a stratified run: separate short (<80), mid (80-300), long (>300) groups and compare. Might be concentrated in mid/long.
Nora: agree. also run human spot-check on ~200 disagreement cases to understand qualitative failure modes. numbers alone won't tell if truncation is unacceptable.
Liam: operationally, what are rollout guardrails? any auto-fallback?
ravi: current plan: 5% staged rollout with autopilot that flips if cohort EM drops >1.0 or if top-percentile latency regresses >2x.
Priya: suggest adding a per-prompt signal: if rerank-accept < 0.5 for a session and prompt_len>120 then mark as risky and exclude from sampler cohort.
Nora: good idea. conditional cohorting by prompt features. can be done in the routing policy.
Liam: we should also test a softened accept_threshold: bump from 0.55 -> 0.7 for long prompts and measure effect on both latency and accuracy.
ravi: did a tiny run: accept_threshold=0.7 recovered ~0.9% EM but acceptance rate fell to 61% and p50 latency increased ~10ms.
Priya: cost/benefit trade. pass those numbers to Redwood Optimize so it can produce a pareto with cost vs EM vs latency.
Nora: for the eval, please include per-prompt signals: prompt_len, kv_warmup_hits, accept_rate, top1_prob, token_entropy, and rerank_delta. also export the disagree diffs.
ravi: will add. CI: 95% bootstrap CIs on EM delta for the long stratum: [-3.0, -1.2] so it's significant.
Liam: timeline to run stratified 10k?
ravi: spinning up tomorrow, expect 18-22h on staging. running GPTQ4 vs GPTQ4+sampler, int8 baseline, and int8+sampler arms.
ci-bot: scheduled run "spec-sampler-stratified-2026-03-22" queued on staging (job id 8241)
Priya: once we have results, let's do pairwise diffs and build a checklist for acceptance (EM drop <0.8 for long OR human pass rate >80% on disagreements).
Nora: also capture examples where sampler shortened causal stepswe may be able to add a lightweight prefix-check before accepting a speculative token (heuristic: if prefix contains named entities or numeric tokens, be more conservative).
ravi: noted. adding prefix-entity-safe-mode flag to the local branch.
Liam: final ask: include per-token cost estimates so product can reason about unit economics for switching to sampler; Redwood Optimize can recommend quant+batch knobs.
Priya: uploading extra holdout sets to /mnt/holdouts/spec_sampler_aug_2026 (500 new multi-hop factual prompts).
ravi: thanks all. will post the run summary + top 50 diffs when job completes. :rocket:
